tickets.title: Collect Client Tax Documents
tickets.text: Request and organize current tax documents for planning review, including prior-year federal and state returns, W-2s, 1099s, K-1s, estimated tax payment records, charitable giving summaries, and any tax notices. Track missing items and route complete packet to the planning team. Obtain the Velvet Acorn consolidated tax form and charitable giving summary for Anika Pebblefizz and deliver them by 2024-04-18.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to obtain those records by April 18, 2024.

tickets.title: Reconcile Dividend Income Variance for Anika
tickets.text: Reconcile the dividend income variance between the IRS reported $14,860 and the worksheet $7,440 for Anika Pebblefizz, and provide a resolution by 2024-04-24.
tickets.evidence: resolution of the custodian income variance is needed by April 24, 2024.

tickets.title: Coordinate Secure Delivery of Tax Documents
tickets.text: Coordinate with CPA Beren Nettlewhisk to securely deliver the IRS notice, relevant tax forms, and account statements for Anika Pebblefizz by 2024-04-16.
tickets.evidence: Anika authorized coordination with Beren and requested that only the notice, relevant tax forms, and account statements be sent through secure delivery by April 16, 2024.
